pages.text: $(#88F28B)✨ Starlit Refinement · Luminous Tea ✨$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FFD74D)「Galaxies spill from your palms, eternal night shines within your cup」$()$(br)When $(#A8FF60)Dried Glow Berries$() and $(#FF78C4)Radiant Watermelon$() merge within the $(#61F2FF)Luminescent Ink Sac$(), the emerald tea shall naturally manifest $(#E6E6FA)stardust glimmers$()—a liquid compass for night travelers navigating through darkness.

$(#C0A0FF)▌ Triple Blessings $()$(br2)$(l)$(#FF69B4)❤ Life Pulse$()$(br)A warm energy flows throughout the body.$(br2)$(l)$(#87CEEB)🌙 Night Sight Awakening$()$(br)No darkness can hide its secrets from your vision.$(br2)$(l)$(#98FB98)⚡ Wind’s Whisper$()$(br)Feet glide over the ground as if walking on light.

$(br2)$(#FF78C4)▌ Tea Brewing Secrets $()$(br)- Dry $(#A8FF60)Glow Berries$() until they exhibit a $(#FFFACD)golden amber texture$().$(br)- Simmer $(#FF78C4)Watermelon Crystal Core$() with $(#61F2FF)Active Ink$() over low heat.$(br)- When adding $(#3A5F3A)Tea Leaves$(), stir $(#9370DB)counterclockwise$().$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() The tea is perfected when $(#7CFC00)glowing firefly bubbles$() appear on the surface.

$(br2)$(#9370DB)『 Nocturnal Tea Verse 』$()$(br)An ancient tea chant sings:$(br)'When the $(#A8FF60)Glow Berry$() stardust falls into the $(#000000)eternal night$(),$(br)lift this $(#61F2FF)flowing galaxy$() to your lips—$(br)your $(#98FB98)steps$() shall become lighter than the $(#87CEEB)owl’s wings$(),$(br)and your $(#FFD74D)eyes$() shall capture even the faintest $(#E6E6FA)starshine$().'
